cases.prompt: Listen to the attached audio and identify the dominant audible sound. Reply with JSON fields category, evidence, transcript. Category must be one of silence, speech, steady_tone, changing_tone, noise, repeated_tones, other, uncertain. Give brief evidence based on what you hear. If speech is present, transcribe it in transcript; otherwise use an empty string. If you cannot hear or assess the audio, choose uncertain.
